descriptions: Nia, a 27-year-old Bulgarian woman and fitness creator who lost weight herself. Long dark-brown hair with a slight wave, usually half pulled back with a brown claw clip, light olive skin, hazel eyes, thick natural eyebrows, a small mole on her left cheekbone, small gold hoop earrings. Toned, athletic but realistic body with a slim waist, not a bodybuilder. Warm, honest, slightly playful; she talks to the camera like to a close friend.
